other_addresses_note: None of these is a deployment of record. The five diagnostic addresses are disposable deployments used to see what real validators do with the panel-decided cases; deploy/diagnostics/ holds their runs. The four superseded canonical addresses: the first (15:11Z) had a live run whose own agreement terms set a 60-second appeal window, shorter than the two transactions an appeal takes on StudioNet, so the contract refused the appeal exactly as written - that agreement was then closed through the documented stalled route (UNSETTLED_ADJUDICATION, buyer refunded in full and withdrawn), so it holds no escrow. The second (15:30Z) had an interrupted attempt consume the agreement id AG-000001, which the fixture evidence names inside its own contents. The third (15:43Z) carries the contract as it was before the live readjudication it ran exposed a real fault: a round with every criterion satisfied at 100/100 was held INCONCLUSIVE by an undecided question that could not have changed the verdict. The fix (OUTCOME_INDICATORS) is in the deployment of record; its escrow was returned to the buyer through the stalled route. The fourth (2026-09-12T16:05Z, 0xbB846F3Cc63e0C8fCF138B9CF0e407202158c861) was the deployment of record until its own live run showed validators losing quotes they had copied exactly: its grounding read every line break as an elision and cut an over-long quote once. Diagnostic run four then showed a fault-only question splitting rounds and the panel reading the text of items code had excluded; the deployment of record fixes all three. That run is kept in deploy/superseded/; it held no escrow when it was superseded. The fifth superseded address, 0x972AdCD7e9ac0D93FD8D678c9fF59cf5B714b4c2 (deployed from e2853c7), was the deployment of record until a judge round on 2026-09-21: its delivery could still be submitted after the deadline and cure period, racing the buyer's refund, and its readjudication read every item committed to the agreement rather than the appealed evidence plus what the appeal named. Its live run transcript is in deploy/superseded/0x972AdCD7/; every agreement on it was settled and withdrawn, and its ledger accounts for no escrow and no credit (get_stats). Its chain balance is nevertheless 49999999999999999 atto: the live run's refusal of a funding one wei short of the price raised, and StudioNet keeps the value of a payable transaction that raises. That value is outside the contract's ledger and no method can move it; the same refusal behaves the same way on the current deployment.
